current.text: He re-signed with Sacramento on a 2-year, 11.5 million deal.
His strong run late last season, including a rank of 73rd after the trade deadline, came while Domantas Sabonis, Keegan Murray, DeAndre Hunter and Cardwell were out. All of them are back.
The projected Kings starters are Acuff, LaVine, Hunter, Murray and Sabonis, with nobody pushing that group for a spot.
He is expected to be a reserve big with a smaller role than his late-season starting run.
The experts say his late-season production was not real. Do not draft him off that run. His ESPN categories rank of 111 is too high.

note: Do not draft him in our league. Yahoo ranks him 210th, ESPN ranks him 153rd and both sites value him at 0 USD, which puts him outside the 144 players we draft. The experts say his late-season numbers only came because the Kings starters were hurt. His profile is modest anyway: about 9 to 10 points and 6.6 rebounds, with weak FT%, threes and assists. Keep him on the waiver radar in case Sabonis, Murray or Hunter misses time or gets traded, because that is when he got starter minutes.
